description: Treasure Hunter dialogue for Crystal Ascendancy quest - main merchant interactions

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: That's so much better! I see, this is the translation cipher for the archaic script, it matches up perfectly with my parchment.
Here, take the old parchment, it may help you figure out the secrets of your orb.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: I've done all I can to help you, the rest is up to you <3.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Hmmmm, I can't quite make out the figures. Try to find a way to brighten up the text.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Oh! That orb. I've seen that script somewhere before.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: If I had the proper facilities I could search my archives for it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Oh! That orb. I've seen that script somewhere before.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: I see you still carry the mysterious orb. Have you found the temple yet? The map should guide you to the ancient secrets within.
Safe travels on your journey to the temple!
Your Pokemon with Teleport can help you reach the temple quickly!

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport to the Temple

dialogue_lines.text: Ahh, here it is. An old parchment with the same script. It was donated to me by a trainer exploring in the oceans to the far South East of spawn.
At the moment I don't think you could enter the temple. You'd need a Pokemon that could help you enter.
Wonderful! You brought a pokemon with Dive with you. With their help you can enter the temple!
Here, take this map to the temple near where the parchment was found, you may be able to find a way to decipher them. I'll send my assistant to the temple to meet you there.
It's quite the journey, maybe a Pokemon could help you get there faster.
It's quite the journey, lucky for you one of your pokemon can Teleport you there!

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport to the Temple

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter
dialogue_lines.text: Greetings, adventurer! I collect rare artifacts and treasures. What do you have to offer?
